description: This Java class 'PdfService' provides methods for generating PDF documents, including printing client lists and contracts, using the iText PDF library within a Spring application context.

classes.name: PdfService
classes.description: A Spring service class responsible for generating PDF documents for clients and contracts.

methods.name: printClientList
methods.description: Generates a PDF file listing clients with specified details.

methods.name: makeTablePdf
methods.description: Creates a PDF document with a table based on provided data.

methods.name: printContract
methods.description: Generates a PDF document for a given contract, including client and company details.
